# Blueprint design system

The page is an app-style viewer. A sticky top bar holds the brand and the sheet tabs, and one sheet shows at a time.
Every new piece of UI must reuse the components below. Don't invent new ones, add new colours, or add
external CSS, fonts or scripts.

## Tokens (defined once in `:root`, redefined in two dark-mode blocks)

| Token | Use |
|---|---|
| `--bg` `--surface` `--surface-2` | page, cards, inset areas |
| `--ink` `--muted` | body text, secondary text |
| `--line` `--line-strong` | card borders, SVG box strokes |
| `--accent` `--accent-soft` `--accent-ink` | Platform/CoE, links, active tab, key highlights |
| `--g` `--g-soft` | **Zone G**, personal (green) |
| `--a` `--a-soft` | **Zone A**, business (amber) |
| `--r` `--r-soft` | **Zone R**, restricted (red); also retiring or urgent items |

Rules:
- Never write a literal colour in a component rule or an SVG. Use a token or an existing class.
- If you must add a token, add it to **all three** blocks: `:root`, `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not([data-theme="light"])` and `:root[data-theme="dark"]`.
- Zone colours carry meaning. Use green, amber and red only for Zones G, A and R (red also marks retirements and deadlines). Don't use them for decoration.

## Type

- Fonts are system stacks (`--f-body`, `--f-display`, `--f-mono`), with Segoe UI first. Don't load web fonts.
- `h1`: sheet title, one per sheet. `.panel h2`: panel title. `.kicker`: small uppercase label above a panel title.
- `.eyebrow`: the "Sheet NN · Topic" line above the sheet title. `.sum`: one-paragraph sheet summary, at most ~3 sentences.
- Mono (`.mono`, `<code>`) is only for environment names, codes and commands.

## Components

**Sheet skeleton.** Every sheet follows this order:
```html
<section class="sheet" id="sNN" data-title="Short title" hidden>
  <div class="sheet-hero">
    <div><p class="eyebrow">Sheet NN · Topic</p><h1>Title</h1><p class="sum">…</p></div>
    <div><span class="prod-label">Products on this sheet</span><div class="chips">
      <span class="pchip"><img src="{{IC:apps}}" alt="">Power Apps</span></div></div>
  </div>
  <figure class="diagram">…</figure>           <!-- see blueprint-diagrams skill -->
  <div class="details"> panels… </div>
</section>
```
A new sheet also needs a tab: `<a class="tab" href="#sNN" data-sheet="sNN"><span class="n">NN</span>Label</a>`.
The pager (Previous/Next) is generated by script; don't hand-write it. The build fails if a tab and a sheet don't match.

**Panels.** Put them inside `.details`, a two-column grid that collapses to one column on narrow screens.
- `.panel`: half width. `.panel.wide`: full width. Keep two half-width panels side by side; don't leave one alone in a row.
- `.panel.alert`: red, for deadlines and urgent actions. Remove it once its date has passed.
- `.panel.note`: amber, for "confirm in your tenant" or status caveats.
- `.panel.phase` / `.panel.phase.now`: roadmap phases.

**Tables.** Always `<table class="rt">` with a `<thead>`. Mark the first cell of each row `class="k"`.
On phones, script turns rows into stacked cards using the header text, so every column needs a clear header.

**Tags.** `<span class="tag tg">G</span>`, `ta` (A), `tr` (R), `tp` (Platform), `tx` (neutral, e.g. "overlay").

**Product chips and icons.** Use only the icon placeholders `{{IC:pp|apps|auto|pages|dv|aib|cs}}`. Always show the
product name next to an icon. Never resize an icon so it distorts, and never crop or recolour one (Microsoft's icon terms).

**Decision cards.** Use `.decisions > .decision` with `<span class="id">D# · TOPIC</span><p>…</p>`.

## Writing style

- Plain, direct sentences. Active voice. British spelling (organisation, licence, optimise, colour).
- No marketing words ("seamless", "robust", "leverage", "empower"). No emoji.
- Name things the way Microsoft's admin center names them (e.g. "Managed Environments", "environment groups", "data policies").
- Put dates in the form `1 Nov 2026`. Give a source for every product fact (see the Sources sheet).
- Keep the reference organisation fictional and generic. Never add real company names, tenant IDs or people.

## Before you finish

Run `python build/build.py --check --strict`. It must pass with no warnings.
